method.assignment: Unique CUDA runtime correlationId joins every collected kernel to a host API; API start must lie in same-globalTid request and exactly one FORWARD/SAMPLE NVTX phase. Decode step combines FORWARD and SAMPLE phases with matching step number. Includes preparation, graph kernels, lm_head and sampling; no GPU-time containment assumption.
method.step_span: GPU_kernel_step_span_ms = last assigned kernel end - first assigned kernel start. This is observed GPU kernel hull, not a newly synchronized per-step wall latency.
method.CPU_submission_marker_hull: Host FORWARD/SAMPLE marker hull is asynchronous submission scope; do not add it to GPU time or call it CPU exclusive cost.
method.union: Half-open [start,end) union on the NSYS timebase, independently for all kernels, dense GEMV/GEMM kernels, non-dense kernels and all activity. Dense/non-dense intersection explicitly reported. Summed kernel durations are separate and can overlap.
method.dense_classifier: Case-insensitive gemv|gemm in full demangled kernel name. FlashAttention names contain cutlass::bfloat16_t but no gemm/gemv and are non-dense. Exactly145 dense nodes per decode step =36*4 projections+1lm_head.
method.overlap: Kernel union = dense union + non-dense union - intersection. Do not add CPU API duration, model bandwidth time, NCU node time, or memcpy/memset union on top.
method.gap: GPU kernel hull minus kernel union is unoccupied by collected kernels; it may include copies, runtime scheduling, missing trace activity or profiler effects. Not identified as native CPU time.
method.shape: Logical dimensions and cached compiled contracts are separate from raw launch arguments. NSYS kernel table stores grid/block/resources, not GEMM M/N/K or tensor pointers. Per-node layer/op labels beyond the first are source-order inferences, not direct module-name measurements.

dense_first_node_matching.matching_strength: First dense node after fused embedding+RMSNorm and before RoPE/cache/attention matches cached submod_0's single addmm. B1 GEMV and B2 CUTLASS GEMM differ as implementations of the same source projection; manager descriptors show1/2token graph inputs. B2 has145 projections per batch step, not290 serial projections.
dense_first_node_matching.what_is_not_proven: SQLite has no raw GEMM parameter struct, no matrix pointers, no direct module annotation on kernel row. Grid alone is not an injective mapping to M/N/K; do not infer B2 M from gridX=8 or treat8 as batch.
low_overhead_method: CPU-only now: bind request+DECODE_STEP01 using NVTX/API correlation; select the first gemv|gemm node within first decodeGraph; preserve catalog name/grid/block/graphNodeId plus its preceding embedding/RMSNorm and following RoPE/cache sequence.

Match compiled submod_0 cached source and the graph-manager descriptor token count1/2, with source hashes. This gives a reviewable same-logical-op/shape contract without layer hooks, tensor copies or a new GPU run.

For a future minimal counter replay select exactly first filtered dense node in the first true incremental decodeGraph, not prefill and not an arbitrary global launch ordinal. Validate the observed grid/block and sequence against this ledger, abort attribution if mismatch.

Preserve an NCU launch record containing actual kernel argument dimensions if tooling exposes them, or a CPU/API argument record of cublas addmm/GEMM shape during capture with pointer-to-parameter mapping. If added instrumentation changes the graph/path, label the result diagnostic altered path; do not substitute for native evidence.

Avoid internal nn.Module hooks under native compile/replay; they can be skipped or alter compilation. Do not use seven-pass whole-allocation kernel replay again merely to establish shape: compiled source plus runtime descriptor already narrows this target, while V9 B2 was resource-censored.

DRAM_and_conditional_weight_model.observed_counter_scope: Only one filtered kernel from first decodeGraph of A00_N32 in separate NCU run, seven kernel-replay passes, cache-control none and clock-control none; not whole step and not joined to NSYS timestamp.

resource_context.note: NCU backup-accessible/backed-up bytes are profiler replay state, not application DRAM read counts.

conditional_model.B2_not_two_weight_passes_assumed: One batch GEMM can reuse a weight read for2rows. Two passes would be a separate model, not an inference from B=2.
assumptions: Dense BF16 projections and full-vocabulary tied head evaluated every incremental step; no quantization/compression/speculation/skip/offload.
Output32 minus output1 approximates31 extra forward steps; first prefill/sampling/graph planning may differ, so measured difference is not pure decode.
No-retention scenario rereads dense matrices once per step, ideal perfect within-step reuse. It is a conditional streaming reference, not unconditional physical lower bound.

L2-credit model assumes at most64MiB of persistent weight data, no persistent L1/register residency across steps; all other dense weights fetched from DRAM at least once. Capacity and that assumption are not newly measured.
Nominal rated bandwidth is optimistic; no DRAM counters, achieved clock, refresh, write/activation/KV/logprob overhead, contention or overlap measured.
Ideal B2 reuses same weight pass for both requests, hence batch delta near single average; two independent passes give near2. H2 can also yield ratios near1 or2.

formal_curve_context.interpretation: Small B2/B1 total-slope ratio does not by itself distinguish memory traffic, achieved bandwidth, changed kernels, compute cost or non-dense overhead. Timeline dense/non-dense costs are separate observational evidence.
formal_curve_context.comparison_scope_caveat: Timeline B1 is A00 only. Formal curve ratio uses mean B1 of separately observed A00 and A01; do not equate these denominators.
